errors.text_span: Оста X е обозначена като БВП на човек (в ППС) на човек
errors.evidence: The description redundantly states "на човек" (per capita) twice and omits the part of the label that says "ЕС28=100".

errors.text_span: с начална стойност 30,5 и крайна стойност 83,2
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly uses data point values (which are also inaccurate) to describe the X-axis range. The actual range shown on the axis is from 20 to 90.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като ИЦН, с начална стойност 28,2 и крайна стойност 79,6
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly uses data point values to describe the Y-axis range and omits part of the axis label ("ЕС28=100"). The actual range shown on the axis is from 20 to 90.
The Y-axis has major gridlines and labels at intervals of 10, not 5.

errors.text_span: На синя линия се визуализира БВП на човек (в ППС) за Естония.
errors.evidence: The blue line does not represent only GDP per capita; it represents the relationship between GDP per capita (x-axis) and AICN (y-axis) for Estonia.
The starting X-value for the blue line (Estonia) is approximately 35, not 30.5.

errors.text_span: който достига своя връх около стойност 72,3
errors.evidence: The value 72.3 is the final Y-coordinate for Latvia (orange line), not a peak value for Estonia (blue line).

errors.text_span: На оранжев път са изобразени стойностите на ИЦН за Латвия.
errors.evidence: The orange line does not represent only AICN values; it represents the relationship between GDP per capita (x-axis) and AICN (y-axis) for Latvia.

errors.text_span: Пътят започва на стойност 61,6 и достига 81,6.
errors.evidence: These values are incorrect and seem to be confused with data from other lines. 81.6 is the final X-value for Lithuania (gray line), and 61.6 is not a labeled value. The orange line's X-values range from approximately 31 to 70.

errors.text_span: На сива линия са представени стойностите на ИЦН за Литва.
errors.evidence: The gray line does not represent only AICN values; it represents the relationship between GDP per capita (x-axis) and AICN (y-axis) for Lithuania.

errors.text_span: Линията започва на стойност 66,5 и достига стойност 79,6.
errors.evidence: These values are incorrect and confused with other data points. 66.5 is the final Y-value for Lithuania, not the start. 79.6 is the final Y-value for Estonia (blue line). The gray line's Y-values start around 28.

errors.text_span: който достига своя връх около стойност 83,2
errors.evidence: The value 83.2 is the final X-coordinate for Estonia (blue line), not a peak value for Lithuania (gray line).
The description completely misses the presence of the diagonal black reference line on the chart.
The description fails to mention that all three data series are plotted using lines with circular markers.
